app.name: Projection
app.tagline: Private financial and retirement planning, running on your own machine.
lang.label: Language
home.title: Welcome
home.intro: Model your whole financial life: income, expenses, accounts, debts and milestones such as financial independence or retirement. Your data is stored only on this machine.
home.start: Start by entering your current finances.
home.feature.finances: Record accounts, income, expenses and debts by hand, without linking banks.
home.feature.plan: A month-by-month projection of your net worth to the end of your life.
home.feature.milestones: Milestones such as financial independence that start or stop income and expenses.
home.feature.cashflow: Sankey diagrams of how money flows each year.
home.feature.success: Monte Carlo simulations and tests against historical returns.
home.feature.taxes: Spanish taxes (IRPF), starting with a flat effective rate.
demo.title: Example: the power of compound interest
demo.desc: %s invested today plus %s a month, at a %s annual return over %d years.
footer.privacy: Your data never leaves this machine.
